game_concept: A drag-and-drop algorithm puzzle in The Kingdom: create the requested executable flowchart.
theme: The Kingdom – Wall Battlements: the high battlements
core_gameplay_loop: Read the requested procedure, drag flowchart shapes into the chart, then run checks against example inputs and expected outputs.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Read a rectangle's width and height. Calculate its area and display the result. Problem values 20, 5; test inputs [{'width': 15, 'height': 5}, {'width': 5, 'height': 6}, {'width': 15, 'height': 7}, {'width': 5, 'height': 8}, {'width': 5, 'height': 9}, {'width': 15, 'height': 10}, {'width': 20, 'height': 20}, {'width': 20, 'height': 5}].
controls: Drag flowchart symbols onto numbered positions and follow the arrows. Check chart executes every case. Arrow keys and Enter also place selected blocks.
win_condition: Build a complete chart whose execution produces the required outputs for every example input.
lose_condition: The run ends after the available unsuccessful chart checks are used.
learning_alignment: CP1 Week 1: Controls and mission practice
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Trace Table Race' (Week 1 slot 14), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Wall Battlements'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Drag correctly shaped blocks into the chart and follow the arrows.
Select Check chart to run example inputs. Revise incorrect steps and try again.
source_game_title: Trace Table Race – Wall Battlements Rush
hint: Trace the arrows. Read input before using it; use rectangles for assignments and diamonds for decisions.
